verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The explicit CRLF/LF tokenizer preserves all pre-existing body bytes while replacing or appending only the limits line, retains the replaced line's terminator, and uses the record's observed terminator for an append without a trailing newline. The added literal-expectation tests cover exotic splitlines-only characters, decoy limits text, replacement, no-op, CRLF append, empty input, and the actual gh edit body delivery path. I found no correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect in the diff.
